comment: ЗАМОК ИДЕНТИЧНОСТИ. Единственный источник текста о героях для промо-генераций. Менять одежду можно — менять пропорции, лицо и постоянные элементы нельзя. Правки здесь автоматически попадают во все промпты и брифы (studio/engine/promo.py).
style_block: Modern stylized volumetric 3D cartoon style: sculpted soft forms, painterly textures, appealing caricature proportions, clean silhouette, no harsh outline, soft rim light, warm skin with subtle subsurface scattering on cheeks and ears.
light_block: Lighting: soft key light from upper-left, gentle rim light 20–30 %, soft shadow falloff, no spotlights, no lens flares, no vignette.

cast_rules.rule: В групповом кадре порядок всегда слева направо: папа, мама, сын. Высоты — по линейке семьи, не «на глаз». Больше трёх героев в кадр не ставим: лица мельчают и перестают читаться в превью.

text_policy: DO NOT render any text, letters, captions, logos, watermarks or UI. Keep the cap letter P and the ABC print on the boy's hoodie only, exactly as in the reference. All headlines are added later as our own typographic layer.
negative: no extra limbs, no extra fingers, no duplicate hands, no merged fingers, no distorted face, no changed hairstyle, no changed beard shape, no glasses, no watch, no jewellery except mom's thin gold chain with one small cross, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no text, no letters, no captions, no handwriting on cardboard boxes, no shipping labels, no printed labels, no barcodes, no speech bubbles, no photographic realism, no flat 2D vector look, no harsh black outlines, no heavy outlines, no neon colours, no busy background, no chromatic aberration, no depth-of-field blur on faces

dad.label: Папа
dad.identity_block: DAD — a 32-year-old father with a stocky, bear-like build, broad shoulders, thick forearms, short legs and a large head. Round friendly face, strong square-ish jaw, big ears, thick expressive eyebrows, warm brown eyes (#5B3A29). Short dark-brown hair (#4A332A) with shaved faded sides and a spiky top. Full neat dark beard and moustache; the beard line runs along the cheekbones. Permanent outfit unless stated otherwise: light-gray crewneck sweatshirt (#C9C7C2), dark jeans (#2F3540), brown sneakers (#4A3A32).
dad.short_block: the stocky bearded dad in the light-gray crewneck sweatshirt
locked: форма бороды и линия роста волос
forbidden: не менять форму бороды и виски
не менять цвет и объём волос
не делать его худым или спортивным

dad.face_anchors: Контрольные точки: 1) линия бороды по скулам, 2) выбритые виски с чёткой границей, 3) широкая переносица и крупный нос, 4) густые брови почти без изгиба, 5) крупные уши, выступающие из-за головы.
dad.lock_line: Keep dad's silhouette EXACTLY as in the reference: wide heavy-set torso, broad shoulders, thick forearms, SHORT legs, large head. Do not slim him down, do not lengthen his legs.

mom.label: Мама
mom.identity_block: MOM — a 31-year-old mother, softly rounded silhouette, half a head shorter than dad, round friendly face with a soft chin, large light blue-gray eyes (#73879A), small nose, warm smile lines. Long wavy chestnut-blonde hair (#9A7856) with a side-swept fringe and one loose curl that falls over the forehead. Permanent outfit unless stated otherwise: brown puffer vest (#5B4034), fitted white top (#F5F1E8), dark skinny jeans (#2F3540), beige home slippers; one thin gold chain with a single small cross.
